create_causal_mask: create a causal attention mask for decoder-only models using config, inputs_embeds, and past_key_values
create_sliding_window_causal_mask: create a sliding window causal mask for models like Mistral with a configurable window size
create_chunked_causal_mask: create a chunked causal mask for models like Llama4 with a configurable chunk size
create_masks_for_generate: create attention masks for generation with support for hybrid layer types and custom mask overlays
build_attention_mask_visual: build a visual string representation of an AttentionMask tensor with customizable grid size and style
